description: SwiftUI view implementation for the RootCanvas component, managing onboarding, settings, chat sheets, and gateway status display with various UI overlays and state management.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing onboarding, settings, chat, and gateway status overlays with state and environment management.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data structure representing the state of the home canvas UI.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Data structure representing individual agent cards in the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Sub-view rendering the main content area with toolbar and overlays.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: View providing a flash overlay effect based on camera nonce.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines initial presentation route (none, onboarding, settings) based on gateway and onboarding state.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides if quick setup sheet should be presented based on various state flags.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables device idle timer based on scene activity and preventSleep setting.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates debug status display on the app model's screen.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Encodes and updates the home canvas state JSON for UI display.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Constructs the payload data for the home canvas based on current app and gateway status.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the currently active agent ID based on app model state.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Returns the default agent ID from the app model.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Generates a list of agent cards for display, marking active and default agents.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns normalized name for an agent.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates badge string for an agent, using emoji or initials.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace and returns nil if empty.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to present onboarding or settings based on current state.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing gateway configuration.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Automatically opens settings sheet if conditions are met.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Determines if quick setup sheet should be shown.
